label: The selected Church predicate applies exactly when the same society…, by Universal generalization…
rule: Universal generalization, biconditional introduction, conjunction introduction and elimination
meaning: The selected Church coextends with the joint criterion (visible with authority and spiritual community), from three OPEN inclusions: the Church is visible, the Church is spiritual, and what is visible and spiritual is the Church. The forward direction uses the first two, the backward direction the third; no premise states the biconditional.
